Max preview / image load size in megabytes

strings.[\"updates\",\"connectionRetry\"]: ViberVN Bot couldn't reach the update server. Check your internet connection and try again. If you use a remote ViberVN Bot, make sure it is online.

strings.[\"updates\",\"availableBodyNoChangelog\: A newer version is ready. Release notes aren’t available for this install type.
strings.[\"updates\",\"availableBodyAppInstaller: A new version of ViberVN Bot is ready. ViberVN Bot will close, Windows will finish the update, and ViberVN Bot will reopen on its own.

strings.[\"updates\",\"manualPickedUpBackend\"]: The backend picks up the new version after the update completes.
strings.[\"updates\",\"guiSkewBody\"]: The backend was updated, but this desktop app package wasn’t changed. Update or reinstall the ViberVN Bot desktop app (your AppImage / .deb / .rpm) to match.
strings.[\"updates\",\"applyingBody\"]: The ViberVN Bot updater takes over in its own window and reopens ViberVN Bot automatically when it’s done. Please don’t reopen ViberVN Bot yourself while it’s updating.
strings.[\"updates\",\"applyingBodyBackend\"]: The remote backend is applying the update and will restart. ViberVN Bot reconnects automatically when it’s back.
strings.[\"updates\",\"applyingClose\"]: This window will close while the update runs, then ViberVN Bot reopens on its own.
strings.[\"updates\",\"applyingBodyAppInstaller\: ViberVN Bot will close and Windows will finish the update. ViberVN Bot will reopen when it’s done — you don’t need to do anything.
strings.[\"updates\",\"applyingCloseAppInstaller: This window will close, Windows finishes the update, and ViberVN Bot reopens on its own.
strings.[\"updates\",\"checkUnknownBodyAppInstal: Windows couldn’t check for updates right now. Updates also install automatically when you restart ViberVN Bot.
strings.[\"updates\",\"errorBody\"]: No worries — nothing was lost. You can try again now.

strings.[\"updates\",\"foreignBlockerTitle\"]: Close other processes to update ViberVN Bot
strings.[\"updates\",\"foreignBlockerBody\"]: ViberVN Bot can’t safely close these processes automatically. Close the app, terminal, or service that owns each one, then try the update again.
strings.[\"updates\",\"mixedBlockerBody\"]: ViberVN Bot can close the local previews listed below. Other processes must be closed manually before the update can continue.
strings.[\"updates\",\"clientAlsoBehindMessage\": The backend is up to date, but this desktop app is still on an older version. Update it to pick up the latest fixes.

strings.[\"updates\",\"applyStatus\",\"notAvaila: Update not available for this backend.

strings.[\"updates\",\"tapCheck\"]: Tap "Check now" to look for updates.
strings.[\"updates\",\"bundleOutOfSyncDesc\"]: The ViberVN Bot runtime was updated, but the desktop app itself is still an older build. Update it to pick up the latest fixes.
